profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I am a Full Stack Web Developer, Audio Producer, and Musician with a never-ending passion for creating. I studied Computer Science at Cal Poly SLO and spent over 5 years working in the radio industry before beginning my tech career.

I went through a Fullstack web development bootcamp in 2018 and currently work for Matchfire where I became certified as a Journeyman Software Developer from the state of California.

Proficient – Javascript, React, React Native, Vue, PHP, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Node, jQuery, graphQL
Knowledgeable – Java, three.js, Chai, SQL, Swift
Some Experience – C++, C, Python

Audio Production Software - Ableton, Logic, Adobe Audition

GitHub - https://github.com/Badbradsback

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Building CMS driven sites with a focus on custom animated components and pages
- Developing and supporting commerce apps built with React Native

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description: Independent game development with a focus on 3D physics-based games

positions.title: On-Air Personality/Promotions Assistant
positions.description:
- Hosted a radio show every weekday on KRUSH 92.5.
- Recorded daily news segments and helped produce weekly talk shows

positions.title: Air Staff Instructor/DJ
positions.description:
- Hosted multiple radio shows
- Managed admissions of new members for the club.
- Taught a 1-hour class every week to ~20 new members.

educations.schoolName: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo
